business_problem: Zhicheng Technology needed to turn large, messy, high-frequency industrial data into an AI-consumable asset base and agent platform while keeping graph queries, writes, and service uptime within strict manufacturing requirements.
solution_summary: Zhicheng Technology built an industrial data-asset and agent-development platform with Huawei Cloud so manufacturers can turn raw operational data into LLM-ready industrial applications. At the ingestion and availability layer, ECS and CCE provide dual-site resilience, remote disaster recovery, and rolling updates so the platform stays online while factories keep streaming data. For the graph layer, Huawei Cloud linkX handles billion-scale daily node and edge updates and millisecond queries across dense industrial relationships. On top of that, iDME contributes industrial knowledge models and data-connection capabilities, while Zhicheng’s own knowledge-compression and large-model logic transform raw plant data into consumable assets. The result is a stack where industrial source data is stored, modeled, queried, compressed, and then exposed to domain agents through Chuntie Fusion and Chuntie Cognite, replacing static dashboards with interactive AI applications for manufacturing users.

solution_components.name: Chuntie Fusion

business_outcome: Zhicheng eliminated downtime, improved industrial data-model efficiency, and gave customers a faster way to build private industrial knowledge graphs and AI applications.

The stack is designed to replace dashboard-only data consumption with AI agents.
The product exposes separate Fusion and Cognite layers for application building and agent development.

data_flow: Factory data streams into ECS/CCE-backed services, where linkX stores and updates dense industrial graphs in near real time. iDME and Zhicheng's compression logic convert those graphs into structured data assets, which are then exposed through Chuntie Fusion and Chuntie Cognite for industrial-agent use.
